_source: Watched in the built-in browser 2026-11-24: frames at 0, ~2, then every 5-15 s, audio probe on two. Our own descriptions; shots approximate; words not counted (no transcript), so words are 0.

hook.firstFrame: dark relief map with a gold Devanagari title and a painting card of a battle

shots.picture: title in large gold Devanagari over a dark relief map, a battle painting inset
an empire painted blue grows across the map with a red outline, chapter title on top
red arrows draw the march route city by city
battle sites marked by orange shapes joined by arrows, chapter titles change
return route drawn across a desert band labelled on the map
dark card: 'what if' question with two numbered answers and a comment button

lines.gist: why did the man who won half the world turn back
the march from Greece to the Indus
a hard battle in monsoon rain
his army refused to go further
asks viewers to pick what would have happened

whyItWorks: Devanagari chapter titles keep a long Short in parts
the route is drawn as the narrator speaks
a two-option comment poll at the end
